meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 构建或修改了网页、组件或终端界面后,Claude 会先截取界面画面,再用两道只读审查(一道查设计系统与功能,一道查视觉与中日韩文显示)核对,最后给出「好/坏」的结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或修改了任何界面(网页、组件、终端文字界面)之后,或询问界面看起来对不对时触发;提到「视觉检查」「截图对比」「设计系统检查」等也会触发。

say.text: 我刚改了网页布局,帮我做一次视觉检查。
say.note: Claude 会截图并执行两道检查后给结论。

say.text: 对比这张设计稿和当前页面,找出差异。
say.note: 它会生成像素级差异报告。

say.text: 终端里表格边框对不齐,CJK 文字有截断,帮我检查。
say.note: 它会抓取终端画面并检查宽字符对齐。

howto.what_en: After you build or change any web or terminal UI, Claude captures screenshots or TUI captures, runs two read-only review passes (design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK), and gives a good/bad verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you build or change any UI (web page, component, or terminal UI), when you ask if it looks right, or when you mention visual QA, screenshot diffs, or design-system checks.

say_en.text: I just changed the web layout; run a visual QA.
say_en.note: Claude captures evidence and gives a good/bad verdict.

say_en.text: Compare this design mock with the current page and list differences.
say_en.note: It generates a pixel-level diff report.

say_en.text: Terminal table borders misalign and CJK text clips; inspect it.
say_en.note: It captures the terminal frame and checks CJK alignment.
